insight: Leads that get a discovery call held within 3 days of first contact are roughly 2x more likely to convert into a qualified Opportunity.
Opportunities where budget and decision-maker are both confirmed within the first two weeks close about 25% faster than ones left open-ended.
Qualified deals with scope/requirements captured within 5 days maintain the highest close rates before momentum fades.
Proposals followed up within 3 days of being shared convert roughly 2x more often than ones left to sit unchased.
Deals in Negotiation historically close faster after an immediate follow-up meeting within 48 hours of the last exchange.
Deals where signature is requested within 2 days of final approval close before the signer loses momentum.
Accounts with no activity in 10+ days have a meaningfully higher risk of going cold - a light-touch re-engagement (e.g. a product update or case study) often revives them.
Deals with an open unfulfilled commitment to the customer stall measurably longer than deals where promised follow-ups are sent on time.
